ns2:section.sectionText: Full course title: Social sensing and human cyber-physical systems. Online social media, smartphones, and ubiquitous internet connectivity have greatly facilitated data sharing at scale, allowing for a firehose of human and sensor observations to pour in about the physical world in real-time. This opens up unprecedented challenges and opportunities in the field of social sensing and human cyber-physical systems (H-CPS). This course offers students the opportunity to learn the theoretical foundations, state-of-the-art techniques, and hands-on experience in this exciting area. Graduate student questions may be sent to ischool-advising@illinois.edu
